remarks: This bright and lovely one-bedroom apartment, nestled in Stamford's sought-after Cove area, offers a dedicated home office space, laminate flooring throughout, and a private balcony. Freshly painted and flooded with natural light, the unit features recessed lighting that adds a warm, welcoming touch. Coin operated laundry is conveniently located on the second floor, dedicated basement storage is included, and reserved covered parking is available near the entrance. Just minutes from waterfront parks, Interstate 95, and the restaurants and shops of downtown Stamford, this location offers easy access to everything you need. Credit score of 670 or above required.
